HOW IT WORKS

Real Feedback, Every Rep

No guesswork about whether you're doing it right — TheraMotion watches your form the same way a therapist would, in real time.

1
Set Up
Prop your phone up and step into view — no extra equipment needed.
2
Move
Follow guided exercises shown right on screen, at your own pace.
3
AI Checks
The app tracks your movement and checks your form on every single rep.
4
Feedback
Real-time tips in your therapist's voice, while your therapist tracks your progress.

THE EXERCISES

Built Around Real Recovery Movements

Four core exercises, each with its own dedicated form-checking model — not a one-size-fits-all approach.

Shoulder Flexion
Guided range-of-motion practice for the shoulder, checkpoint by checkpoint.
Hand to Mouth
Rebuilding a core daily-living motion, with real-time gate checks against compensation.
Sit to Stand
Practicing a functional movement that matters most for everyday independence.
Knee Extension
Full-extension tracking with a hybrid model that catches what angle alone can miss.

STAY MOTIVATED

See Every Rep Add Up

Every session is scored, saved, and compared against your own history — so progress is something you can actually see, not just something you're told is happening.

Real-time form score, every set
Session history you can look back on
Trend tracking that flags when to adjust
